elements.title: Must authors use the specified spacing as their default?

elements.title: What letter spacing must be accommodated?

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: What can fail in a fixed-height card after spacing changes?

explanations.q_1: The requirement is that user overrides cause no loss.
explanations.q_2: The specified letter-spacing value is 0.12 times font size.
explanations.q_3: Increased spacing can exceed the available height.
